in_hebrew.name: Leigh
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Leigh הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘leah’, meaning ‘open woodland’ or ‘clearing’. It was used as a surname and given name in England and later in other English-speaking countries. The name is now predominantly used for females, although it was historically used for males as well.
